full_judgment: 3. The defendants in the written statement denied the allegations made in the plaint. The case for the Government (Defendants) is that the suit property (being a tank measuring more than 4 bighas of land) is recorded in the khas khatian not of the Collector, Dhaka. Zamindar Manmatha Bennerjce purchased the estate including the suit tank from the legal heirs of Shyama Sundari Dasya and thereafter Zaminder of Bhagyakul, Gunendur Krishna Roy Bahadur after obtaining a money decree against Monmatha in Money Suit No.34 of 1934 in the First Court of the Subordinate Judge, Dhaka auction purchased the estate of Manmatha including the suit tank in execution of that decree in Money Execution Case No.157 of 1935 aid obtained possession of the same through Court. The Bhagyakul Zamiadars possessed and managed the suit pond as their khas land. After the wholesale acquisition of the Zamindaries thd suit property became the khas land of the Government and the suit property has since been possessed and managed by the Government as khas land. The plaintiff-opposite parties have got no right, title, possession or interest in the suit land and therefore defendant No.1 rightly refused to accept any rent from the plaintiff. By filing the present Title Suit No. 68/1986 in the First Court of Subordinate Judge. Dhaka fraudulently and collusively the plaintiff-opposite parties managed to get a decree in their favour on 27.3.88 practising fraud upon the court and the decree drawn up on 27.3.88.
